detail.requirements:
• 7+ years of IT implementation experience
• Experience and technical expertise (design and implementation) in cloud computing technologies
• Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
• Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
detail.main_tasks:
• Dive deep into inventory and application data of the customer's on-premise services to assess the portfolio and develop decision criteria to create initial migration wave plans.
• Analyze the customer's existing infrastructure design including network, storage, computing resources, along with the operational processes / policies to design a secure, robust, and highly tolerant multi-account AWS environment based on AWS best practices.
• Develop required operating and governance models, and help customers to migrate applications to AWS.
• Help customers and partners to be prepared for cloud operations, and identify the areas for automation to accelerate the migration and transformation of the organization.
• Establish the future operating model for cloud and plan, guide and support an efficient progression of the operational model during the migration.
• Deliver Pilot projects, topical workshops, and lead implementation projects.
• Travel to client locations and deliver professional services as needed.
detail.intro: At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we're hiring highly technical cloud computing architects to help our customers develop technical expertise and capacity, while also collaborating with our customers and partners on key engagements. Our consultants will deliver Pilot projects, topical workshops, and lead implementation projects. Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for customers, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about strong success for the Customer.
detail.benefits:
• Diverse experiences valued — non-traditional career paths encouraged
• Mentorship and career growth resources including knowledge-sharing and career-advancing programs
• Inclusive team culture with employee-led affinity groups
• Work/life balance with flexibility as part of working culture
• Access to AWS Training and Certification, AWS Support and Managed Services
detail.preferred_points:
• Experience leading the design, development and deployment of business software at scale or recent hands-on technology infrastructure, network, compute, storage, and virtualization experience
• Experience facilitating discussions with senior leadership regarding technical / architectural trade-offs, best practices, and risk mitigation
